scenes.narration: When you pay for an Uber, how much do you think Uber actually keeps?
About 30 percent. That was Uber's average cut of ride bookings at the end of 2025.

visual.label: Uber's cut of ride bookings, Q4 2025

scenes.narration: On food delivery, its cut is lower, around 19 percent. But restaurants also pay Uber to advertise inside the app.
In 2025, people booked 193 billion dollars of rides and deliveries on Uber. Uber turned that into 52 billion in revenue.
Uber doesn't own the cars or the restaurants. It owns the app in the middle.
